rationale: Source is a design brainstorm with additive verbs (add performatives, extend AgentRegistry, add blackboard, add carriers) and an explicit 'Does NOT exist yet — VERIFY' list. Research must (a) verify each VERIFY claim against the codebase, (b) locate the integration points the sister spec would extend (AgentRegistry, AgentCrew/AgentsFlow, WorkingMemory, ToolManager, A2A, Matrix integration, eventbus, AuditLedger, PBAC), and (c) surface existing patterns to follow. Early scan already contradicts one VERIFY claim: packages/ai-parrot-integrations/src/parrot/integrations/matrix/ and docker-compose.matrix.yml exist.

queries.intent: Orient: AgentRegistry — how agents are registered (decorator), what remote-agent kinds exist, whether capabilities are indexed.

params.question: AgentRegistry register_agent remote agents kind registry

queries.intent: Orient: how agents talk to each other today inside a crew — output hand-off format between run_sequential/run_parallel steps.

params.question: AgentCrew run_sequential run_parallel agent output passed to next agent

queries.intent: Orient: WorkingMemory toolkit — how stored results / dataframes are held and referenced (handle-like keys, Arrow/Polars).

params.question: working memory toolkit stored results dataframes wm_store_result

queries.intent: Verify the brainstorm's claim 'no Matrix integration exists' — orient on parrot.integrations.matrix.

params.question: Matrix integration room events homeserver client

queries.intent: Orient: PBAC / policy enforcement at tool execution — is there a reusable policy gate.

params.question: PBAC policy enforcement tool execution authorization gate

queries.intent: Orient: AuditLedger — signed append-only ledger referenced by both brainstorms.
Orient: navigator-eventbus usage inside ai-parrot (default carrier candidate).

params.question: eventbus publish subscribe navigator event bus

queries.intent: Orient: A2A client/server — the closest existing agent-to-agent protocol surface (agent cards, tasks).

params.question: A2A agent card task client server a2a_agent

queries.intent: Orient: ToolManager — tool registration/removal lifecycle and per-session identity (needed for catalog.mount and caller identity).

params.question: ToolManager register tool remove tool lifecycle per-session identity

queries.intent: Orient: shared state between flow nodes (FlowContext) — the closest thing to a blackboard today.

params.question: FlowContext shared state between nodes crew shared memory

queries.intent: Orient: existing tools that let one agent call another (delegate, ask_agent, crew tools).

params.question: delegate task to another agent tool ask agent crew agent-as-tool

queries.intent: Read the AgentRegistry page in full: API outline (register/lookup), remote-agent model fields.
Follow AgentRegistry edges to find who consumes the registry (A2A, manager, crew builders).
Read the AgentCrew page: how step results flow, what type the hand-off is (AIMessage text vs structured).
Read the WorkingMemory toolkit page: storage keys, dataframe handling, Arrow/Polars presence.
Read the Matrix integration page: what exists (client, room events, state events), maturity.
Read the AuditLedger page (or top result): location, signing, what records it holds.
List the registry module files to ground later reads.
Read the AgentRegistry implementation: entry model (kind, endpoint), register/lookup API, any capability/keyword index.
Verify VERIFY-claim: registry has no capability search / locality ranking; also find remote/a2a kinds.
Verify VERIFY-claim: no performative / speech-act / conversation threading fields anywhere in core.
List bots/flows/core to locate Node, FlowContext and the message/result types that a protocol engine would sit on.
Read bots/flows/tools.py: the existing agent-callable tools for delegation (origin tools for request/cfp).
Locate crew hand-off: how run_sequential feeds output to the next agent (text prompt vs typed object) and how run_loop stops.
Read the crew hand-off code around the matches in Q026 to see the exact type passed between agents.
List the Matrix integration package (contradicts the brainstorm's VERIFY claim).
Read the Matrix integration main module: client library used, event types handled, room state usage, whether custom event types exist.
Read docker-compose.matrix.yml: what homeserver stack is already provisioned for local development.
Find eventbus usage in parrot (default carrier): which package, which API (publish/subscribe/topics).
List working_memory package to ground the read of the toolkit.
Read the WorkingMemory toolkit: how results are stored (key, metadata, preview), per-agent scoping, dataframe import/export.
Verify VERIFY-claim on zero-copy: Arrow/Polars presence in working memory and stores (by-reference handles).
Locate AuditLedger (both brainstorms depend on it) — file list.
Locate PBAC / policy enforcement classes — is there a reusable gate keyed by capability, and where tool execution is policy-checked.
Read ToolManager: registration/removal lifecycle, per-session identity, execute path (where catalog.mount and the gating would hook).
List A2A packages (core + server + integrations) to locate the agent-card / task models and client.
Read bots/a2a_agent.py: how a parrot agent is exposed/consumed via A2A today (closest inter-agent surface).
Loop termination / budget today: hop limits, max_iterations, token budgets in crew + flow executors.
Read FlowContext / shared state in bots/flows/core (closest existing blackboard; single-writer, versioning?).
Existing tests for crew, registry, working memory and matrix — coverage baseline.
Trace / correlation propagation today (shared trace_id in parent envelope).
Verify VERIFY-claim: no shared versioned key-value blackboard with ACLs in flows (shared_memory, blackboard, SharedContext).
Agent-level grants / config: how an agent's allowed tools/agents are configured (register_agent decorator args, agent config, allowed_agents).
Recent activity on the registry (is it being extended right now; FEAT ids touching it).
Recent activity on bots/flows (crew + flow + core) — active development area per CONTEXT.md.
History of the Matrix integration — when it landed, which FEAT, how complete.
Recent activity on working_memory toolkit (handles/dataframes).
Recent activity on A2A surfaces (core + server).
Find SDD specs/proposals already covering matrix, eventbus, audit ledger, registry — prior decisions to respect.

expected_findings: AgentRegistry entry model and API; confirmation that no capability index / locality ranking exists
Exact hand-off type between crew agents today (text vs typed) and loop termination mechanics
What the existing Matrix integration already provides (client lib, event types, room state) — corrects the brainstorm
WorkingMemory storage model and Arrow/Polars presence (zero-copy feasibility)
Location and shape of AuditLedger, PBAC/policy enforcement, eventbus usage, trace propagation
ToolManager lifecycle hooks where catalog.mount and the gating layer would attach
Confirmation of absence: performative/protocol engine, blackboard, inter-agent grant
Prior SDD decisions touching matrix / registry / audit / eventbus
